title: METTA: Memory-Enhanced Test-Time Adaptation for Meta-Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: METTA：面向元强化学习的记忆增强测试时自适应

paragraphs.en: Meta-reinforcement learning aims to train agents that adapt quickly to unseen tasks from limited interaction, but this requires representing task evidence over long interaction histories. Classical recurrent agents compress experience into hidden states, while transformer-based agents retrieve from past trajectories at quadratic memory and computation cost. In this work, we propose Memory-Enhanced Test-Time Adaptation ( Metta ) for meta-reinforcement learning. It decomposes the fast adaptation phase into two temporal scales: a causal neural memory performs fine-grained within-episode adaptation with linear sequence complexity, while compact episode-level summaries support long-range cross-episode task inference without attending over the full interaction history. Moreover, equipping agents with neural memory provides sufficient expressive capacity and test-time training capability, enabling effective adaptation to unseen held-out tasks and task families at meta-test time. On unseen held-out Meta-World ML10/45 test environments, Metta achieves a success rate over 50 % 50\% while maintaining a low training budget and short wall-clock time. On long-context sparse-reward PointMaze tasks, it outperforms transformer-based baselines by exhibiting more structured exploration behavior. These results show that Metta provides an efficient path toward more adaptive and scalable long-context meta-RL.

paragraphs.en: Reinforcement learning (RL) studies how agents learn to make sequential decisions through interaction with an environment, using rewards as feedback to improve future behavior ( Sutton and Barto, 2018 ) . Despite strong performance in fixed environments, standard RL methods often require large amounts of data to adapt to new tasks and generalize poorly under environment shifts ( Packer et al., 2018 ; Cobbe et al., 2019 ) . Meta-reinforcement learning addresses this limitation by training agents over a distribution of tasks so they can use past training experience to adapt quickly to unseen tasks from limited interaction at meta-test time ( Duan et al., 2016 ; Wang et al., 2016 ; Finn et al., 2017 ; Rakelly et al., 2019 ) . A fundamental problem in meta-RL is representing task evidence collected during interaction with the environment ( Humplik et al., 2019 ; Zintgraf et al., 2021 ) . Black-box sequence-based agents learn this representation directly from trajectories using internal dynamics ( Duan et al., 2016 ; Wang et al., 2016 ; Mishra et al., 2018 ; Alver and Precup, 2021 ) . Latent-context methods instead make task inference more explicit by inferring a task variable or belief from collected experience ( Humplik et al., 2019 ; Rakelly et al., 2019 ; Zintgraf et al., 2021 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 强化学习（RL）研究智能体如何通过与环境交互学习做出序贯决策，并利用奖励作为反馈来改进未来行为（ Sutton and Barto, 2018 ）。 尽管在固定环境中表现优异，标准强化学习方法通常需要大量数据才能适应新任务，并且在环境变化下泛化能力较差（ Packer et al., 2018 ; Cobbe et al., 2019 ）。 元强化学习通过在任务分布上训练智能体来解决这一局限，使其能够利用过去的训练经验，在元测试时通过有限的交互快速适应未见过的任务（ Duan et al., 2016 ; Wang et al., 2016 ; Finn et al., 2017 ; Rakelly et al., 2019 ）。 元强化学习中的一个基本问题是如何表示在与环境交互过程中收集到的任务证据（ Humplik et al., 2019 ; Zintgraf et al., 2021 ）。 基于黑盒序列的智能体利用内部动力学直接从轨迹中学习这种表示（ Duan et al., 2016 ; Wang et al., 2016 ; Mishra et al., 2018 ; Alver and Precup, 2021 ）。 潜变量上下文方法则通过从收集到的经验中推断任务变量或信念，使任务推断更加显式（ Humplik et al., 2019 ; Rakelly et al., 2019 ; Zintgraf et al., 2021 ）。

paragraphs.en: Transformers offer a natural alternative because self-attention enables associative retrieval over past interactions and supports long-range dependency modeling without relying on recurrent state compression ( Vaswani et al., 2017 ; Melo, 2022 ; Shala et al., 2025 ) . This makes them well suited to cross-episode meta-RL, where useful evidence may appear far back in the trial ( Mishra et al., 2018 ; Shala et al., 2025 ; Melo, 2022 ) . However, standard self-attention scales quadratically with sequence length ( Vaswani et al., 2017 ; Duman Keles et al., 2023 ) , making long adaptation horizons increasingly expensive in online RL settings. Prior work also showed that transformer optimization in reinforcement learning can be unstable due to exploration dynamics and non-stationary training signals ( Parisotto et al., 2019 ) . In online meta-RL, the effective context grows with both the episode horizon and the number of adaptation episodes, making full-history attention increasingly expensive in memory and computation. As a result, transformer-based agents often face a trade-off between retaining long histories and remaining computationally practical.
paragraphs.zh: Transformer 提供了一种自然的替代方案，因为自注意力能够对过去的交互进行关联式检索，并支持长程依赖建模，而无需依赖循环状态压缩（Vaswani et al., 2017；Melo, 2022；Shala et al., 2025）。 这使得它们非常适合跨回合的元强化学习，因为有用的证据可能出现在很久以前的试验中（Mishra et al., 2018；Shala et al., 2025；Melo, 2022）。 然而，标准自注意力的计算量随序列长度呈二次增长（Vaswani et al., 2017；Duman Keles et al., 2023），这使得在在线强化学习环境中，长适应周期的开销越来越高。 先前的工作还表明，由于探索动态和非平稳的训练信号，强化学习中的 Transformer 优化可能不稳定（Parisotto et al., 2019）。 在在线元强化学习中，有效上下文随着回合长度和适应回合数的增加而增长，使得对完整历史的注意力在内存和计算上的开销越来越高。 因此，基于 Transformer 的智能体常常面临保留长历史与保持计算可行性之间的权衡。

paragraphs.en: The computational overhead of full-history attention has motivated a recent shift toward modern linear recurrent models and neural memory architectures ( Gu et al., 2021 ; Smith et al., 2022 ; Gu and Dao, 2023 ; Sun et al., 2023 ; Sun et al., 2025 ) . Instead of attending over the full history, these methods update an adaptive memory state online while preserving linear sequence complexity. Recent work suggests that recurrence need not be limited to a small passive hidden state and can instead be equipped with expressive state dynamics or trainable memory modules, allowing models to store information over long horizons while preserving linear sequence complexity ( Gu and Dao, 2023 ; Sun et al., 2025 ) . In particular, Test-Time Training (TTT) ( Sun et al., 2025 ) treats memory as a trainable module that can be updated continually during inference, turning sequence processing from passive state compression into adaptive memory updating. This has led to promising results in settings where long-range information is essential, including language modeling, time series, genomics, novel-view synthesis, and video generation ( Sun et al., 2025 ; Behrouz et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ; Dalal et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 全历史注意力带来的计算开销促使近期研究转向现代线性循环模型与神经记忆架构（ Gu et al., 2021 ； Smith et al., 2022 ； Gu and Dao, 2023 ； Sun et al., 2023 ； Sun et al., 2025 ）。 这些方法不再对全部历史进行注意力计算，而是在保持线性序列复杂度的同时在线更新一个自适应的记忆状态。 近期工作表明，循环机制不必局限于一个小型被动的隐藏状态，而是可以配备更具表达力的状态动力学或可训练的记忆模块，使模型在保持线性序列复杂度的同时能够长时程地存储信息（ Gu and Dao, 2023 ； Sun et al., 2025 ）。 特别是，测试时训练（TTT）（ Sun et al., 2025 ）将记忆视为一个可在推理过程中持续更新的可训练模块，把序列处理从被动的状态压缩转变为自适应的记忆更新。 这在长程信息至关重要的诸多场景中取得了可喜的成果，包括语言建模、时间序列、基因组学、新视角合成和视频生成（ Sun et al., 2025 ； Behrouz et al., 2025 ； Zhang et al., 2025 ； Dalal et al., 2025 ）。

paragraphs.en: In this work, we propose Memory-Enhanced Test-Time Adaptation ( Metta ), which leverages TTT layers ( Sun et al., 2025 ) as a modern neural memory module to gather task evidence from long-range interaction sequences in meta-RL. Besides this within-episode memory module, which provides fine-grained episode-level memories, we also use a coarse-grained aggregation mechanism that combines summaries across episodes. Thus, in addition to the classical slow and fast learning processes in meta-RL, our fast adaptation phase separates within-episode adaptation from cross-episode evidence aggregation, allowing the policy to condition on longer meta-test histories without relying on quadratic computation over agent interaction steps.
paragraphs.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出了记忆增强测试时自适应（Metta），它利用TTT层（Sun et al., 2025）作为现代神经记忆模块，从元强化学习中的长程交互序列里收集任务证据。 除了这个提供细粒度回合级记忆的回合内记忆模块之外，我们还使用一种粗粒度聚合机制来整合跨回合的摘要。 因此，除了元强化学习中经典的慢学习和快学习过程之外，我们的快速自适应阶段将回合内自适应与跨回合证据聚合分离开来，使策略能够以更长的元测试历史为条件，而无需在智能体交互步骤上进行二次方计算。

paragraphs.en: Our experiments across locomotion, manipulation, and navigation benchmarks show that Metta improves fast adaptation in both standard and long-context meta-RL settings. Interestingly, the relative gain over existing methods is especially notable when generalizing to unseen held-out Meta-World task families that are not encountered during meta-training. This provides evidence of task-family-level out-of-distribution generalization, where adaptation transfers to task families not observed during meta-training. This suggests that neural memory modules can support adaptation beyond the task families observed during training.

paragraphs.en: The distinction between inner-loop and outer-loop parameters is central to TTT. paragraphs.en: We evaluate the effectiveness of our method on standard meta-RL benchmarks covering locomotion, manipulation, and navigation tasks. We evaluate continuous-control adaptation on MuJoCo HalfCheetahVel ( Todorov et al., 2012 ) , where the agent must infer the target velocity from interaction. We use a limited training budget to compare how efficiently each method adapts under restricted environment interaction.

paragraphs.en: Next, we evaluate robotic manipulation on ML1, ML10, and ML45 from the Meta-World benchmark ( Yu et al., 2020 ) . In ML1, following the standard baseline convention, goal coordinates are masked and must be inferred through interaction. ML10 and ML45 span multiple task families with disjoint train and test splits, allowing us to evaluate generalization to families not observed during meta-training. We view this as a form of task-family-level OOD evaluation, since the held-out test families are encountered only at meta-test time. In these settings, goal coordinates are included in the observation, while the task family remains fixed within each trial. During multi-class training, each rollout batch assigns environments to task classes in a balanced way and then samples a task variation within each class.
paragraphs.zh: 接下来，我们在 Meta-World 基准（Yu et al., 2020）的 ML1、ML10 和 ML45 上评估机器人操作。 在 ML1 中，按照标准的基线惯例，目标坐标被遮蔽，必须通过交互来推断。 ML10 和 ML45 涵盖多个具有互斥训练与测试划分的任务族，使我们能够评估对元训练期间未见过任务族的泛化能力。 我们将其视为一种任务族层面的分布外（OOD）评估，因为留出的测试族只在元测试阶段遇到。 在这些设置中，目标坐标包含在观测中，而任务族在每个试验内保持固定。 在多类别训练过程中，每个回合批次以平衡的方式将环境分配到任务类别，然后在每个类别内采样一个任务变体。

paragraphs.en: We compare Metta against representative meta-RL baselines from recurrent, gradient-based, latent-context, and transformer-based families. RL 2 uses recurrent state to implement black-box adaptation from interaction history ( Duan et al., 2016 ) , while MAML learns an initialization that can be adapted with gradient updates ( Finn et al., 2017 ) . PEARL and VariBAD represent latent-context approaches that infer task variables from collected experience ( Rakelly et al., 2019 ; Zintgraf et al., 2021 ) . For transformer-based meta-RL, we compare against TrMRL, which uses self-attention over trajectory context ( Melo, 2022 ) , ECET, which improves cross-episode conditioning ( Shala et al., 2025 ) , and AMAGO, an in-context RL agent trained on long sequences ( Grigsby et al., 2024 ) . For all baselines, we use the default implementations and hyperparameters from their respective repositories. All methods use the same evaluation protocol. Results are averaged over five seeds, with shaded regions showing ± 1 \pm 1 SEM. Additional details are provided in Appendix D .
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 Metta 与来自循环、基于梯度、潜在上下文和基于 Transformer 等系列的有代表性的元强化学习基线进行比较。 RL 2 使用循环状态根据交互历史实现黑盒适应（Duan et al., 2016），而 MAML 学习一个可以通过梯度更新进行调整的初始化（Finn et al., 2017）。 PEARL 和 VariBAD 代表潜在上下文方法，它们从收集的经验中推断任务变量（Rakelly et al., 2019；Zintgraf et al., 2021）。 对于基于 Transformer 的元强化学习，我们与 TrMRL（它对轨迹上下文使用自注意力（Melo, 2022））、ECET（它改进了跨回合条件化（Shala et al., 2025））以及 AMAGO（一个在长序列上训练的上下文内强化学习智能体（Grigsby et al., 2024））进行比较。 对于所有基线，我们使用其各自仓库中的默认实现和超参数。 所有方法均使用相同的评估协议。 结果在五个随机种子上取平均，阴影区域表示 ± 1 \pm 1 标准误（SEM）。 更多细节见附录 D。

paragraphs.en: Figure 4 shows adaptation performance on the Meta-World benchmark. On simpler settings such as ML1, Metta quickly improves over adaptation episodes, indicating that the neural memory can infer task-relevant information from limited interaction. On the more challenging ML10 and ML45 benchmarks, Metta surpasses other baselines by a large margin across diverse task families.
paragraphs.zh: 图 4 展示了在 Meta-World 基准上的适应性能。 在 ML1 等较简单的设置中，Metta 在适应回合中快速提升，表明神经记忆能够从有限的交互中推断与任务相关的信息。 在更具挑战性的 ML10 和 ML45 基准上，Metta 在多样化任务族中大幅超越其他基线方法。

sents.en: Figure 4 shows adaptation performance on the Meta-World benchmark.

sents.en: On simpler settings such as ML1, Metta quickly improves over adaptation episodes, indicating that the neural memory can infer task-relevant information from limited interaction.

paragraphs.en: The performance gap is notable not only on train environments, where evaluation uses task families observed during meta-training, but also on the Meta-World test environments (up to a ∼ 40 % \sim 40\% success-rate margin), which consist of unseen held-out task families. This result indicates that the learned adaptation mechanism of Metta generalizes beyond the task families encountered during meta-training. In our experiments, this generalization is substantially stronger than that of RL 2 ( Duan et al., 2016 ) , suggesting an advantage of adaptive neural memory over conventional autoregressive recurrent conditioning, which relies on passive and less expressive memory updates during inference.

paragraphs.en: To isolate the contribution of test-time memory adaptation, we evaluate Metta with its online memory updates disabled while retaining cross-episode aggregation. paragraphs.en: We presented Metta , a meta-RL framework based on neural memory and test-time training. The method separates fast adaptation into within-episode online memory updates and cross-episode evidence aggregation, allowing the agent to leverage long interaction histories without attending over the full history. This temporal hierarchy provides an efficient mechanism for long-context adaptation with linear sequence complexity. Unlike standard recurrent approaches that rely on passive memory updates during inference, the TTT module performs gradient-based memory updates, providing an additional mechanism for fast adaptation to previously unseen task families.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 Metta，一个基于神经记忆和测试时训练的元强化学习框架。 该方法将快速适应分离为回合内的在线记忆更新和跨回合的证据聚合，使智能体能够利用长交互历史，而无需对完整历史进行注意力计算。 这种时间层级为长上下文适应提供了一种具有线性序列复杂度的高效机制。 与在推理过程中依赖被动记忆更新的标准循环方法不同，TTT 模块执行基于梯度的记忆更新，为快速适应先前未见过的任务族提供了额外的机制。

paragraphs.en: Experiments on HalfCheetahVel, Meta-World, and sparse-reward PointMaze showed that Metta improves adaptation across both standard and long-context meta-RL settings while maintaining favorable computational efficiency. The gains were especially strong on unseen held-out Meta-World task families, providing further evidence that neural memory with test-time adaptation can support task-family-level OOD generalization to previously unseen, novel task families. Our findings also suggest a promising direction for future work that extends Metta beyond the fixed-task trial setting considered here, for example by incorporating temporal or recency information into the cross-episode memory for continual or nonstationary environments that require fast online adaptation as task structure, dynamics, or rewards change over time.
paragraphs.zh: 在 HalfCheetahVel、Meta-World 和稀疏奖励 PointMaze 上的实验表明，Metta 在标准与长上下文元强化学习设置中都能提升适应能力，同时保持良好的计算效率。 在未见的留出 Meta-World 任务族上收益尤为显著，进一步证明带测试时适应的神经记忆能够支持任务族级别的分布外泛化，推广到此前未见的新任务族。 我们的发现还指出了一个有前景的未来研究方向，即将 Metta 扩展到本文所考虑的固定任务试验设置之外，例如在跨情节记忆中引入时间或近因信息，以应对任务结构、动力学或奖励随时间变化、需要快速在线适应的持续或非平稳环境。

paragraphs.en: Reinforcement learning methods often achieve strong performance within a fixed environment but generalize poorly across tasks or changing dynamics ( Sutton and Barto, 2018 ; Packer et al., 2018 ; Cobbe et al., 2019 ) . This limitation motivated research on meta-learning, where models are trained over a distribution of tasks to learn transferable inductive biases that improve adaptation to unseen settings ( Hospedales et al., 2020 ; Bengio et al., 1990 ; Thrun and Pratt, 1998 ) . Early meta-learning work showed that experience across tasks can improve fast adaptation to unseen settings ( Finn et al., 2017 ; Santoro et al., 2016 ; Vinyals et al., 2016 ) . Meta-RL extends this idea to sequential decision making, where the agent must infer task structure and adapt behavior using limited interaction data ( Duan et al., 2016 ; Wang et al., 2016 ; Finn et al., 2017 ) . Unlike conventional RL, which optimizes a single policy for one environment, meta-RL explicitly targets fast adaptation under task variation.
paragraphs.zh: 强化学习方法通常能在固定环境中取得较强性能，但在跨任务或动态变化的环境下泛化能力较差 ( Sutton and Barto, 2018 ; Packer et al., 2018 ; Cobbe et al., 2019 ) 。 这一局限推动了元学习方面的研究，即让模型在任务分布上训练，以学习可迁移的归纳偏置，从而提升对未见环境的适应能力 ( Hospedales et al., 2020 ; Bengio et al., 1990 ; Thrun and Pratt, 1998 ) 。 早期的元学习研究表明，跨任务的经验可以加快对未见环境的快速适应 ( Finn et al., 2017 ; Santoro et al., 2016 ; Vinyals et al., 2016 ) 。 元强化学习将这一思想扩展到序贯决策中，此时智能体必须利用有限的交互数据推断任务结构并调整行为 ( Duan et al., 2016 ; Wang et al., 2016 ; Finn et al., 2017 ) 。 与针对单一环境优化单一策略的传统强化学习不同，元强化学习明确地以任务变化下的快速适应为目标。

paragraphs.en: Meta-learning methods are commonly divided into optimization-based, metric-based, and memory-based approaches. Optimization-based methods learn parameters or update rules that support rapid adaptation through gradient-based learning ( Finn et al., 2017 ; Nichol et al., 2018 ; Andrychowicz et al., 2016 ) . Metric-based methods instead learn embedding spaces for fast similarity-based generalization ( Vinyals et al., 2016 ) , while memory-based approaches use recurrent architectures or external memory to encode task information over time ( Santoro et al., 2016 ) . Although most meta-RL work builds on optimization-based learning ( Finn et al., 2017 ) , recurrent adaptation and latent memory mechanisms became particularly important because RL environments are sequential and partially observable.
paragraphs.zh: 元学习方法通常分为基于优化的方法、基于度量的方法和基于记忆的方法。 基于优化的方法学习能够通过基于梯度的学习实现快速适应的参数或更新规则（Finn 等，2017；Nichol 等，2018；Andrychowicz 等，2016）。 基于度量的方法则学习嵌入空间以实现基于相似度的快速泛化（Vinyals 等，2016），而基于记忆的方法使用循环架构或外部记忆来随时间编码任务信息（Santoro 等，2016）。 尽管大多数元强化学习（meta-RL）工作建立在基于优化的学习之上（Finn 等，2017），但由于强化学习环境是序贯且部分可观测的，循环适应和潜在记忆机制变得尤为重要。

paragraphs.en: Early meta-RL methods mainly relied on recurrent policies that implicitly infer task identity from trajectories by compressing interaction history into recurrent hidden states. RL 2 ( Duan et al., 2016 ) formulated the problem as learning an RL algorithm inside a recurrent network, where hidden states encode adaptation behavior ( Wang et al., 2016 ) . Subsequent work improved task inference using probabilistic latent variables and context encoders. VariBAD ( Zintgraf et al., 2021 ) modeled meta-RL as approximate Bayesian inference over hidden task variables, while PEARL ( Rakelly et al., 2019 ) introduced off-policy probabilistic context adaptation and significantly improved sample efficiency. Other influential methods include ProMP ( Rothfuss et al., 2018 ) , MAESN ( Gupta et al., 2018 ) , and Meta-Q-Learning (MQL) ( Fakoor et al., 2020 ) , which use recurrent or latent context encoders to improve adaptation efficiency and task inference. Gradient-based meta-RL approaches directly adapted MAML to policy optimization settings ( Al-Shedivat et al., 2018 ) , enabling fast policy adaptation using a few gradient steps.
paragraphs.zh: 早期元强化学习方法主要依赖循环策略，通过将交互历史压缩进循环隐状态，从轨迹中隐式推断任务身份。 RL 2（Duan et al., 2016）将该问题形式化为在循环网络内部学习一个强化学习算法，其中隐状态编码自适应行为（Wang et al., 2016）。 后续工作利用概率隐变量和上下文编码器改进了任务推断。 VariBAD（Zintgraf et al., 2021）将元强化学习建模为对隐藏任务变量的近似贝叶斯推断，而 PEARL（Rakelly et al., 2019）引入了离线策略的概率上下文自适应，显著提升了样本效率。 其他有影响力的方法包括 ProMP（Rothfuss et al., 2018）、MAESN（Gupta et al., 2018）以及 Meta-Q-Learning（MQL）（Fakoor et al., 2020），它们使用循环或潜在上下文编码器来提升自适应效率和任务推断能力。 基于梯度的元强化学习方法将 MAML 直接适配到策略优化场景（Al-Shedivat et al., 2018），仅需少量梯度步骤即可实现策略的快速自适应。

paragraphs.en: A major challenge in meta-RL is balancing exploration and adaptation under partial observability, particularly when task-relevant evidence is sparse or delayed. In many benchmarks, the underlying task is hidden and must be inferred from sparse interactions. This led to methods that explicitly separate task inference from control ( Rakelly et al., 2019 ; Zintgraf et al., 2021 ) . Bayesian formulations became especially influential because they model uncertainty over latent task identity and support structured exploration policies. VariBAD ( Zintgraf et al., 2021 ) and PEARL ( Rakelly et al., 2019 ) showed that latent posterior estimation improves adaptation efficiency and robustness. Related work also studied exploration-driven adaptation, where agents learn information-seeking behaviors that reduce uncertainty during early episodes ( Gupta et al., 2018 ; Stadie et al., 2015 ) . These formulations closely connect meta-RL with partially observable Markov decision processes and Bayesian reinforcement learning ( Guez et al., 2014 ) , where the agent must maintain and update beliefs over latent task structure.
paragraphs.zh: 元强化学习的一大挑战是在部分可观测条件下平衡探索与适应，尤其是当与任务相关的证据稀疏或延迟时。 在许多基准测试中，底层任务是隐藏的，必须从稀疏的交互中推断出来。 这催生了一些显式地将任务推断与控制分开的方法（Rakelly et al., 2019；Zintgraf et al., 2021）。 贝叶斯形式化方法影响尤为深远，因为它们对潜在任务身份的不确定性进行建模，并支持结构化的探索策略。 VariBAD（Zintgraf et al., 2021）和 PEARL（Rakelly et al., 2019）表明，潜在后验估计能提升适应效率和鲁棒性。 相关工作还研究了由探索驱动的适应，其中智能体学习那些能在早期回合中减少不确定性的信息寻求行为（Gupta et al., 2018；Stadie et al., 2015）。 这些形式化方法使元强化学习与部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程以及贝叶斯强化学习（Guez et al., 2014）紧密关联，在这些设定下，智能体必须对潜在任务结构维护并更新信念。

paragraphs.en: Attention mechanisms and transformer architectures have been applied to reinforcement learning and meta-reinforcement learning to improve long-range retrieval over interaction histories ( Mishra et al., 2018 ; Parisotto et al., 2019 ; Chen et al., 2021 ) . Recent transformer-based meta-RL methods such as TrMRL ( Melo, 2022 ) , ECET ( Shala et al., 2025 ) , and AMAGO ( Grigsby et al., 2024 ) use sequence modeling over trajectories or episodes to improve task inference and adaptation. These methods reduce reliance on compressed recurrent states and improve long-context reasoning. However, the high memory usage and quadratic computation cost of self-attention make transformer-based methods less suitable for long-horizon sparse-reward settings. In contrast, Metta uses neural memory with linear-time recurrent updates, preserving both high expressivity and linear sequence complexity, which makes it scalable to considerably longer horizons.
paragraphs.zh: 注意力机制与Transformer架构已被应用于强化学习和元强化学习中，以提升对交互历史的长程信息检索能力（Mishra et al., 2018；Parisotto et al., 2019；Chen et al., 2021）。 近期基于Transformer的元强化学习方法，如TrMRL（Melo, 2022）、ECET（Shala et al., 2025）和AMAGO（Grigsby et al., 2024），通过对轨迹或回合进行序列建模来改进任务推断与适应。 这些方法减少了对压缩式循环状态的依赖，并提升了长上下文推理能力。 然而，自注意力的高内存占用与二次方计算开销，使得基于Transformer的方法不太适合长时程稀疏奖励的场景。 相比之下，Metta采用线性时间循环更新的神经记忆，既保留了高表达能力，又具备线性序列复杂度，这使其能够扩展到长得多的时程。

paragraphs.en: Linear-time alternatives to quadratic self-attention have been studied through recurrent, linear-attention, and state-space sequence models. State-space and linear recurrent models such as S4 ( Gu et al., 2021 ) , S5 ( Smith et al., 2022 ) , RWKV ( Peng et al., 2023 ) , RetNet ( Sun et al., 2023 ) , and Mamba ( Gu and Dao, 2023 ) improve scalability through recurrent memory updates and causal streaming inference. Linear and kernelized attention methods ( Katharopoulos et al., 2020 ; Choromanski et al., 2021 ) reinterpret attention as associative recurrent computation with subquadratic complexity. More recent neural memory approaches extend recurrent sequence models beyond passive hidden-state compression by updating memory parameters during inference. Test-Time Training (TTT) layers ( Sun et al., 2025 ) formulate the hidden state as a learnable model optimized online through self-supervised updates, while Titans ( Behrouz et al., 2025 ) introduces persistent neural memory modules for long-range associative retrieval. These architectures provide efficient long-horizon memory and online adaptation mechanisms that are well suited to meta-reinforcement learning and partially observable environments.
paragraphs.zh: 已经通过循环、线性注意力和状态空间序列模型研究了二次方自注意力的线性时间替代方案。 诸如 S4（Gu et al., 2021）、S5（Smith et al., 2022）、RWKV（Peng et al., 2023）、RetNet（Sun et al., 2023）和 Mamba（Gu and Dao, 2023）等状态空间和线性循环模型，通过循环记忆更新和因果流式推理提升了可扩展性。 线性和核化注意力方法（Katharopoulos et al., 2020；Choromanski et al., 2021）将注意力重新解释为具有低于二次方复杂度的关联循环计算。 更近期的神经记忆方法通过在推理期间更新记忆参数，将循环序列模型扩展到超越被动隐藏状态压缩的范畴。 测试时训练（TTT）层（Sun et al., 2025）将隐藏状态表述为一个通过自监督更新在线优化的可学习模型，而 Titans（Behrouz et al., 2025）则引入了用于长程关联检索的持久神经记忆模块。 这些架构提供了高效的长时程记忆和在线自适应机制，非常适合元强化学习和部分可观测环境。

sents.en: Linear-time alternatives to quadratic self-attention have been studied through recurrent, linear-attention, and state-space sequence models.

sents.en: Test-Time Training (TTT) layers ( Sun et al., 2025 ) formulate the hidden state as a learnable model optimized online through self-supervised updates, while Titans ( Behrouz et al., 2025 ) introduces persistent neural memory modules for long-range associative retrieval.

sents.en: These architectures provide efficient long-horizon memory and online adaptation mechanisms that are well suited to meta-reinforcement learning and partially observable environments.

paragraphs.en: Standard PPO implementations often construct minibatches by randomly sampling timesteps from the rollout buffer. For adaptive sequence models, this is inefficient. Evaluating a randomly selected timestep requires reconstructing the neural-memory state by forwarding the trajectory from the beginning of the trial up to that point. Random timestep sampling therefore repeatedly recomputes overlapping prefixes.
paragraphs.zh: 标准的 PPO 实现通常通过从 rollout 缓冲区中随机采样时间步来构建小批量（minibatch）。 对于自适应序列模型而言，这种做法效率低下。 评估一个随机选择的时间步，需要从试验开始处对轨迹进行前向计算，重建到该时点为止的神经记忆状态。 因此，随机时间步采样会反复重复计算相互重叠的前缀。

paragraphs.en: To improve training efficiency, we perform PPO optimization sequentially over trajectory segments. Each trial is divided into ordered segments that are processed chronologically, and the PPO loss is applied only to the current segment. In our experiments, each segment corresponds to one episode within the trial. This avoids repeatedly reconstructing arbitrary trajectory prefixes and roughly halves the PPO update time in our implementation.
paragraphs.zh: 为提高训练效率，我们按轨迹分段依次执行PPO优化。 每次试验被划分为按时间顺序处理的有序分段，且PPO损失仅应用于当前分段。 在我们的实验中，每个分段对应试验中的一个回合。 这避免了反复重建任意轨迹前缀，并在我们的实现中将PPO更新时间大致缩短了一半。

paragraphs.en: During rollout collection, the TTT fast weights and cross-episode summaries evolve causally and are used for action selection, while the behavior-policy log probabilities and value estimates are stored. PPO optimization then reconstructs the memory state from the stored interactions rather than reusing the rollout memory states. For a segment in episode e e , all preceding episodes and the required prefix of episode e e are reprocessed using the current slow parameters. After the PPO loss for that segment is backpropagated and the slow parameters are updated, the computation graph is discarded. The causal history required for the next segment is therefore recomputed using the updated parameters, so memory states produced before an optimizer step are never reused by later segments.
paragraphs.zh: 在rollout采样过程中，TTT快权重和跨回合摘要以因果方式演化并被用于动作选择，同时行为策略的对数概率和价值估计会被存储下来。 PPO优化随后从存储的交互中重建记忆状态，而不是复用rollout时的记忆状态。 对于回合 e e 中的某个片段，所有先前的回合以及回合 e e 所需的前缀会使用当前的慢参数重新处理。 在该片段的PPO损失完成反向传播并更新慢参数之后，计算图会被丢弃。 因此，下一个片段所需的因果历史会使用更新后的参数重新计算，所以优化器步骤之前产生的记忆状态永远不会被后续片段复用。

paragraphs.en: Meta-World is a popular benchmark in the field of meta-reinforcement learning, focusing on robotic manipulation tasks, which enables evaluation in few-shot adaptation. These tasks vary in objectives, object geometries, and interaction dynamics while sharing a common robot embodiment (Sawyer arm) and action space, enabling structured transfer and meta-learning evaluation. We evaluated our algorithm, Metta , on three families of environments within this benchmark.
paragraphs.zh: Meta-World 是元强化学习领域一个流行的基准，聚焦于机器人操作任务，可用于评估小样本适应能力。 这些任务在目标、物体几何形状和交互动力学上各不相同，但共享同一个机器人本体（Sawyer 机械臂）和动作空间，从而支持结构化迁移与元学习评估。 我们在该基准的三个环境家族上评估了我们的算法 Metta。

paragraphs.en: Let T T denote the number of timesteps per episode, E E the number of episodes in a trial, e e the current episode index, and t t the current timestep. We analyze scaling with interaction-history length while treating hidden dimensions and network depths as constants. Existing complexity analyses for sequence-based meta-RL typically characterize the cost of constructing a context representation at a single decision point rather than the computation accumulated throughout an online trial. For example, ECET ( Shala et al., 2025 ) reports 𝒪 ⁡ ( T 2 + E 2 ) \mathcal{O}(T^{2}+E^{2}) for its hierarchical attention, corresponding to one context construction when the episode-level transformer evaluations are treated as parallel operations. In online meta-RL, however, action selection occurs at every timestep, so the full-trial complexity naturally accumulates this computation across all timesteps and episodes. We therefore report both the per-decision cost and the total computation over the complete trial.
paragraphs.zh: 设 T 表示每个回合的时间步数，E 表示一次试验中的回合数，e 表示当前回合索引，t 表示当前时间步。 我们在将隐藏维度和网络深度视为常数的情况下，分析与交互历史长度相关的扩展性。 现有针对基于序列的元强化学习的复杂度分析，通常刻画的是在单个决策点构建上下文表示的开销，而非在整个在线试验中累积的计算量。 例如，ECET（Shala et al., 2025）针对其分层注意力报告了 𝒪(T²+E²) 的复杂度，这对应于当回合级 Transformer 评估被视为并行操作时的一次上下文构建。 然而，在在线元强化学习中，动作选择发生在每个时间步，因此整次试验的复杂度会自然地在所有时间步和回合上累积这一计算。 因此，我们同时报告单次决策的开销和完整试验中的总计算量。

paragraphs.en: Figure 9 shows that the Metta framework can operate with different within-episode sequence models, while their adaptation behavior differs substantially. On PointMaze, TTT achieves the strongest and most consistent test performance, while the linear Transformer approaches it later in training and GRU and Mamba remain lower. The differences are also clear on ML10 test tasks: TTT and the linear Transformer achieve substantially stronger generalization than GRU and Mamba, despite all variants learning the training tasks effectively. These results show that the overall framework is not tied to a particular sequence architecture, while the choice of within-episode memory remains important for test-time adaptation and generalization.
paragraphs.zh: 图 9 表明，Metta 框架可以在不同的片段内序列模型下运行，而它们的适应行为存在显著差异。 在 PointMaze 上，TTT 取得了最强且最稳定的测试性能，线性 Transformer 在训练后期逐渐接近它，而 GRU 和 Mamba 仍然较低。 在 ML10 测试任务上差异也很明显：尽管所有变体都能有效学会训练任务，TTT 和线性 Transformer 的泛化能力显著强于 GRU 和 Mamba。 这些结果表明，整体框架并不依赖于特定的序列架构，而片段内记忆的选择对于测试时适应和泛化仍然十分重要。

paragraphs.en: Figure 10 shows that the aggregation mechanism has relatively little effect on training performance but becomes substantially more important at test time. On ML10, removing cross-episode aggregation leads to consistently lower test success, remaining around 0.3 0.3 , while softmax attention, EMA ( α = 1 / 2 \alpha=1/2 ), and linear attention all benefit from reusing information across episodes. On PointMaze, the no-aggregation variant learns much more slowly at test time and remains near zero during approximately the first 0.5 0.5 M environment steps, whereas the aggregation-based variants begin improving substantially earlier. This further highlights the importance of reusing evidence collected in previous episodes for adaptation on held-out tasks.

paragraphs.en: Among the aggregation mechanisms, softmax attention provides the strongest overall trade-off across the four settings. EMA performs competitively on several test settings but is less stable on PointMaze and somewhat weaker on ML10 training tasks. Linear attention closely tracks softmax attention during training and reaches strong PointMaze test performance, but is less consistent on held-out tasks. These results support retaining a selective cross-episode retrieval mechanism while showing that Metta is not restricted to a single aggregation design.

paragraphs.en: Figure 13 shows that both memory variants learn the training tasks effectively, while the higher-capacity memory provides stronger test-time adaptation. We ablate this design by removing the separate state input, forcing the learned representation to jointly encode both the current state and task context.

paragraphs.en: Figure 14 shows that explicitly separating state information from task context has relatively little effect on training performance but improves generalization to held-out tasks. The difference is particularly pronounced on PointMaze, where removing the separate state input causes a large reduction in test success despite maintaining strong training performance. The same trend is visible on ML10, while the two variants are closer on ML45. These results suggest that allowing the memory to focus on task-relevant evidence, while providing the instantaneous state directly to the policy and value function, produces a more effective representation for adaptation than requiring a single learned representation to encode both.
paragraphs.zh: 图14表明，将状态信息与任务上下文显式分离对训练性能的影响相对较小，但能提升对留出任务的泛化能力。 这一差异在 PointMaze 上尤为明显：移除独立的状态输入后，尽管训练性能依然强劲，测试成功率却大幅下降。 在 ML10 上也可以看到同样的趋势，而在 ML45 上两种变体的表现则更为接近。 这些结果表明，让记忆专注于与任务相关的证据，同时将即时状态直接提供给策略和价值函数，比要求单一学习到的表示同时编码两者，能够产生更有效的适配表示。

paragraphs.en: A clear pattern is that, for ECET and TrMRL, trajectories from different episodes often overlap substantially. This suggests that these agents do not effectively use information gathered in previous episodes, and instead tend to repeat similar exploration patterns across the trial. Even when these methods eventually reach the goal, they frequently revisit previously explored paths rather than refining their search based on earlier failures or successes. In TrMRL, this behavior is consistent with limited effective long-context memory across episodes. For ECET, although it explicitly incorporates cross-episode context, the available context is short, which makes it difficult to use previous episode information effectively in this very low-signal sparse-reward environment. Moreover, this behavior remains visible from mid-training to the end of training, indicating that these methods do not substantially improve their ability to reuse previous episodes over the course of learning.
paragraphs.zh: 一个明显的规律是，对于 ECET 和 TrMRL，来自不同回合的轨迹往往有大量重叠。 这表明这些智能体没有有效地利用先前回合中收集到的信息，而是在整个试验中倾向于重复相似的探索模式。 即使这些方法最终到达目标，它们也经常重访先前探索过的路径，而不是基于早期的失败或成功来改进其搜索。 在 TrMRL 中，这种行为与跨回合有限的有效长上下文记忆相一致。 对于 ECET，尽管它显式地纳入了跨回合的上下文，但可用的上下文很短，这使得它难以在这种极低信号的稀疏奖励环境中有效地利用先前回合的信息。 此外，这种行为从中期训练一直持续到训练结束，表明这些方法在学习过程中并没有显著提升其复用先前回合的能力。

paragraphs.en: In contrast, Metta learns a qualitatively different exploration strategy. In particular, it learns to search the maze more broadly in the first episode, and the search space covered by this first episode becomes noticeably larger as training progresses. Later episodes then make better use of the information gathered during this broader initial exploration, leading to more directed behavior toward the goal.
